explanation: This component is 0 almost everywhere and only turns on at the GO step late in the episode (about trial 85 onward), when the agent chooses a2 right after a rewarded trial in which a2 led to S2 by the common route, especially when the trial before that one went unrewarded, so it marks the first win after a loss; it then reaches about 6-10, sometimes only 1-5. It drops back to 0 on the next GO if the reward streak continues, and it is 0 at every D1 and D2, every a1 choice, after rare or unrewarded trials, and in the early and middle part of the episode.
